ideas.title: Following the Money in the Trump Investigation
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial dealings of those involved in the Trump investigation, including James Comey and Joe Kent.
questions: What financial dealings are being investigated?
How are these dealings connected to the Trump investigation?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money in this investigation could lead to significant revelations of wrongdoing. I recommend looking into the financial dealings of those involved and seeing if there are any connections to the Trump investigation.
